scope: Live Gemini plus public Supabase tools; terminal acknowledgments use an in-memory store, not HTTP login or database history persistence.

cases.name: congestion_and_schedule
cases.prompt: Check SEG001 congestion on a weekday at 08:00 Asia/Jakarta and recorded ferry departures from Batu Ampar. Use both registered tools and distinguish synthetic estimates from recorded schedules with unknown freshness.

results.disclaimer: Model trained on synthetic project data; not observed or real-time traffic.
Recorded project schedule; freshness unverified. At most 20 departures returned.

cases.name: saved_reference_followup
cases.prompt: Explain why the previously recorded congestion estimate should not be treated as live traffic. Use only the saved result; do not refetch.

cases.name: missing_route_inputs
cases.prompt: Please find the best route for my delivery.

cases.name: unrelated_request
cases.prompt: Write a fantasy story about a dragon.

limitations: One sample per prompt; latency is not a benchmark.
Clarification and domain-response wording require review; no universal model adherence claim.
No signed-in HTTP, Supabase JWT or database persistence tested.
